name: Saimin no Kanade
source:
Music box is a secret treasure that helps main character to relax and sleep soundly. He is suddenly transferred to an elite high school. It's difficult for him to communicate with the other students due to his low skill level. But one day his secret becomes revealed, and music box gets used as a means of hypnotize.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
音樂盒是能讓主角放鬆並安然入睡的秘密寶物。他突然轉入一所菁英高中，由於跟不上同學的程度，很難與其他學生交流。然而一天，他的秘密遭人發現，音樂盒也被用作催眠工具。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
